profile.headline: Computer Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Engineer specializing in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and scalable systems. Proven track record in deploying high-performance solutions across embedded Linux, IoT, and automation domains. Adept in Python, Rust, and Docker, with strong CI/CD proficiency and a passion for problem-solving. Backed by a Computer Systems Engineering degree from Arizona State University, I thrive on delivering real-time results and continuous improvement in fast-paced environments.

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained OpenStack services.
- On-call customer support for public/private cloud hosting.
- Devops culture
- Agile project management
- CICD
- Developed deployment automation with Puppet

positions.title: Power Applications Intern
positions.description:
Power Applications Intern
-Developed and maintained power measurement and power management
applications.
- Developed automation software to reduce data produced by the teams Power
Profiling Software. The C# program reduces thousands of lines of data in seconds, allowing team
members to be more efficient and increasing their productivity.
- Automated the team’s dynamic testing process. This process tests the accuracy of software and
hardware used to gather CPU power data. The automation reduced testing time dramatically.

positions.title: AT3 Petty Officer
positions.description:
Achieved the rank of AT3 Petty Office and acquired a top-secret clearance.
- Maintained and repaired electronic communications systems, in flight-navigation and
detection systems. Operational level maintenance included; troubleshooting, replacing
module systems, reading schematics and block diagrams, using electronic test equipment,
and corrosion control.
- Time management and multitasking of my primary duties, along with assisting other rates
(mechanics, airframes, and electricians), was necessary to achieve operational readiness.
- Achieved the title plane captain; lead the assembly and briefing of move crews for plane
launches and retrievals. Assisted the pilot in flight preparation and advised the pilot of the
material condition of the aircraft.
